grammar: generic indexed-buffer fill/map plus learned-procedure composition

fill.listing:
fill: learned state transformation
  shape: 2 operand(s) of W bits -> W bits
  vector program (state example search), disassembled from its tensors:
    r0 = input x0
    r1 = input x1
    r2 = zero
    r3 = zero
    r4 = zero
    r5 = zero
    r6 = zero
    r7 = zero
    r8 = zero
    r9 = one
    @0: r3 = file.read(r0)
    @1: r4 = buffer.length(r3)
    @2: (test only); if r4 != 0 goto @3 else @5
    @3: r4 = sub(r4, r9)
    @4: r5 = buffer.set(r3, r4, r1); if r4 != 0 goto @3 else @5
    @5: r8 = file.write(r0, r3)
    result = r8
  learned from 2 training cases and 2 validation cases; 5 steps, 1 candidates

guarded_map.listing:
guarded_map: learned state transformation
  shape: 3 operand(s) of W bits -> W bits
  vector program (state example search), disassembled from its tensors:
    r0 = input x0
    r1 = input x1
    r2 = input x2
    r3 = zero
    r4 = one
    r5 = zero
    @0: (test only); if r2 != 0 goto @1 else halt
    @1: r5 = map(r0, r1)
    result = r5
  learned from 2 training cases and 2 validation cases; 1 steps, 240 candidates

pair_map.listing:
pair_map: learned state transformation
  shape: 3 operand(s) of W bits -> W bits
  vector program (state example search), disassembled from its tensors:
    r0 = input x0
    r1 = input x1
    r2 = input x2
    r3 = zero
    r4 = one
    r5 = zero
    r6 = zero
    @0: r5 = map(r0, r2)
    @1: r6 = map(r1, r2)
    result = r6
  learned from 2 training cases and 2 validation cases; 2 steps, 2508 candidates
